svg.text: Hiwonder Ackermann advanced kit · three identical plates, outline traced from Hiwonder's own CAD · 1.7 px/mm · front of vehicle to the LEFT · viewed from above, so the vehicle's own LEFT is at the BOTTOM of each plan
Deck gaps measured on the built kit 2026-09-20: lower 50 mm, upper 40 mm - two standoff lengths, not one. Fascia panels are 52 and 42 mm tall.
top face z 81.12 · STM32 carrier (boards A, B), 5 V split (board C) and the 5 V converter
top face z 29.12 · floor only - the harness is taped under plate 2 (MEC-16)
pattern 49.00 × 58.00 from NXP drill T11 - 0.06 mm out in x · dashed = its other 2 holes
fascia upper panel clamps here - 2 × M3×8 driven down from the top (MEC-07)
carrier 98 × 106: header row 1 at x 181.20 · 6 × M2.5 on 10 mm standoffs into existing holes (MEC-15)
JGB37-520 ×2 from the CAD: ⌀37 gearbox outboard · ⌀33 can · encoder inboard
motors reach to 29.8 mm from the rear edge - switches stop ~8 mm short
the driver's rear 7 mm sits over the cans - clearance is vertical only, set by the spacer height
widest 120.4 mm at the front axle · 84.7 mm at the waist · 94.2 mm across the rear flat
MIDDLE DECK - plate 2, LOWER FACE: the harness board
seen from below, upside down on the bench - mirrored: vehicle RIGHT at the BOTTOM · 3M foam tape
Drops to plate 1 fold down when plate 2 is lowered: SM-2P at S1 · driver VM at S2/S4 · four switch leads off the trunk · I²C. Thick edge = fuse lid.
Nominal sizes (MEC-16 "To confirm"). Check the carrier and board C screw heads before taping - A2 lands at the motor fuse lid.
fascia upper panel, 42 mm tall: USB-C · DE-9 · Mini-B
fascia lower panel, 52 mm tall: DRIVE / LOGIC switches
below plate 1: running gear, wheels, ground clearance - nothing mounted
WHAT IS FIXED, AND WHAT IS NOT
Measured on the built kit: 50 mm below, 40 mm above. The kit ships two standoff lengths; the
single-plate CAD only ever had the 50 and our 3-deck model repeated it for both gaps. The fascia
panels are therefore 52 and 42 mm tall and are no longer one blank (MEC-09).
Plate 1 wiring - every run, on plate 2's harness board, 2026-09-28 (MEC-16, HW-20)
